apps.name: Melodix
apps.description:
Melodix — Music, Your Way.

Melodix is a modern, free music streaming experience designed for people who simply love music. Discover new tracks, revisit your favourites, create playlists, and enjoy your music in a clean and beautifully crafted interface.

🎧 Discover Your Sound

Explore a growing collection of songs, artists, albums, and genres. Whether you're looking for something new or returning to an old favourite, Melodix makes discovering music effortless.

❤️ Your Music, Your Collection

Save the songs you love and build your personal music library. Create playlists around your mood, taste, or moment and keep everything you enjoy in one place.

🔎 Find It Fast

Search for songs, artists, albums, and more with a simple and intuitive search experience.

🎵 A Beautiful Listening Experience

Melodix focuses on what matters most — your music. Enjoy a clean interface, smooth navigation, and a distraction-free player designed to make listening feel effortless.

✨ Made for Music Lovers

No complicated setup. No unnecessary clutter. Just open Melodix, find something you love, and press play.

Melodix — Discover. Listen. Repeat.
